title: PyLBM-Isca: a Linear Baroclinic Model on the Isca/GFDL spectral core
description: PyLBM-Isca is a moist, dynamics-only Linear Baroclinic Model whose dynamical core is a linearisation of the Isca / GFDL atmos_spectral primitive equations (Simmons–Burridge vertical differencing, pure-sigma coordinate, semi-implicit leapfrog with a Robert–Asselin filter), at T42 L20 on a numpy (CPU) or CuPy (CUDA GPU) backend. It is newly written code that follows the structure of the Watanabe–Kimoto linear baroclinic model while deriving its dynamical core from the GPLv3 Isca sources; it shares no code with the permission-restricted Watanabe–Kimoto ln_solver, so it can be distributed freely under the GPL.
